sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:46 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 4x keys, 2x swipe cards, 2x bodyvests, 1x Ops phone, 2x cameras, 2x camera chargers. All photos/video involving incidents attached following end of shift.
Public Holiday Note: due to the public holiday, stores were expected to open later than usual.
Alpha Route commenced. Arrived at the corner of Queen Street and Wyndham Street. Area checked for issues. All clear.
Arrived at the corner of Queen Street and Shortland Street. Location checked thoroughly. No issues found.
Welfare check completed around Pocket Park for any vagrants. All clear.
Response call received from McDonald's Queen Street regarding a male individual sleeping inside and refusing to leave after staff asked him to exit.

Response call received from The Coffee Club, top of Victoria Street, regarding a female street vagrant blocking the entrance while staff were opening. Advised guards were responding to another incident first.

Arrived at McDonald's Queen Street. Guards woke the POI and politely asked him to leave; he complied. Advised that sleeping inside the lobby is not permitted (customer use only). Footage captured on bodycam.
Arrived at The Coffee Club. POI had already left. Guards maintained presence and commenced welfare checks on nearby stores.
Patrolling down Albert Street towards checkpoints.
Welfare check completed around Cathedral Church and Federal Square. No issues found.
Welfare check completed at Albert Mart Convenience Store and Discount Dairy. All clear.
Arrived at check-in, corner of Customs Street and Albert Street. Area checked thoroughly. All clear.
Arrived at Commercial Bay check-in. Full sweep completed. Welfare checks completed on open stores. All clear.
Security presence maintained while monitoring for further response calls and incidents. Alpha Route ended.
Welfare check completed inside McDonald's Britomart. All clear.
Welfare check completed at Movenpick. No issues.
Arrived at Kiwi Bank check-in. Welfare checks completed on stores within the area. All clear.
Welfare check completed at Giapo, Auckland Harbour Suites, Sienna Cafe, Smiley, and Char Grill. Other stores remained closed due to the public holiday.
Security presence maintained before continuing patrol.
Moving along due to no activity occurring.
Arrived at Wilson Carpark check-in. Checked for vagrants/visible issues. Welfare checks completed on stores within the area. All clear.
Commencing welfare checks along Lower High Street and O'Connell Lane.
Welfare check completed along Vulcan Lane. All clear.
Arrived at Freyberg Place and Women's Memorial Hall. Area checked thoroughly. No issues to report.
Arrived at Chancery Square check-in. Full sweep completed. No issues visible. All clear. Presence maintained before continuing patrols.
Leaving area due to no activity occurring.
Response call received from McDonald's Britomart regarding a male individual sleeping inside the store and not responding to staff.
Arrived at McDonald's Britomart. POI appeared to have left on his own prior to guard arrival. Presence maintained before continuing patrol.
Arrived at the corner of Queen Street and Shortland Street. No issues found.
Leaving area as the POI had not returned. Patrolling up Queen Street and commencing welfare checks on stores along the way.
Arrived at the corner of Queen Street and Wyndham Street. No issues found. Chemist Warehouse checked with no issues.
Arrived at the corner of Queen Street and Victoria Street. All clear.
Arrived at the corner of Lorne Street and High Street. Welfare checks commenced along all stores on Lorne Street. All clear.
Arrived at check-in, corner of Lorne Street and Wellesley Street. Area checked thoroughly. All clear.
Welfare check completed at Auckland Library. All clear.
Welfare check completed at Nando's, Munster Inn, and Queens Food Court. All clear.
Arrived at check-in, top of Mayoral Drive. Location checked thoroughly. All clear.
Arrived at Aotea Square check-in. Full walkthrough completed. No issues present. All clear. Route ended.
Security presence maintained before moving along.
Response call received from Pizza Amour regarding a male individual sleeping in front of their doorstep. Assistance requested to move him along.
Response call received from Cotton On regarding a female individual trespassed from the store, known to be aggressive and non-compliant with staff.

Arrived at Cotton On. Due to the seriousness, Police were called and guards remained on site. Staff advised the POI was calm but wanted guards present in case she became aggressive again. Police en route. Footage captured on bodycam.

Female POI left the store. Police arrived and were advised the POI was at the corner of Queen Street and Victoria Street. Police approached and engaged with her. Guards proceeded to the previous response call.
Arrived at Pizza Amour, Fort Street. Guards woke the POI and asked him to leave due to complaints from the store owner. POI complied.
Arrived at headquarters for morning interval.
Break completed. Patrols continued. Charlie Route commenced.
Arrived at Woolworths and Chemist Warehouse, Victoria Street. All clear.
Arrived at top of Victoria Street check-in. Welfare checks completed on stores within the area. All clear. Presence maintained.
Leaving area and heading back down Queen Street to show presence.
Arrived at the corner of Customs Street and Queen Street. No issues found.
Welfare check completed at McDonald's Britomart. All clear.
Arrived at Commercial Bay check-in. Full walkthrough completed. All clear. Presence maintained.
Leaving area due to no activity occurring.
Arrived at Metro Woolworths Albert Street. Stopped to get drinks and checked in with static guards. All clear.
Arrived at check-in, corner of Customs Street and Albert Street. No issues found. Patrolling up Albert Street.
Arrived at the corner of Wyndham Street and Albert Street. Welfare checks completed at Hollywood Cafe, Good To Go Supermarket, and Barclay Suites. All clear.
Welfare check completed at Little Albert's Cafe, Formery, and Sky Mart Convenience Store. All clear.
Arrived at headquarters for lunch break and prepared for changeover. Monitoring for response calls.
Morning shift completed. Equipment handover completed.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Afternoon shift deployed. Equipment handover completed.
Alpha Route commenced. Arrived at check-in, corner of Victoria Street East and Queen Street. Welfare checks completed, all clear:
Arrived at SkyWorld Entertainment Centre and Aotea Square check-in. All clear.
Returned to headquarters to charge Ops phone (sitting at 3% and about to power off). Camera shown.
Ops phone at 31%. Patrol routes recommenced.
Welfare checks completed at Durham Street West and East alleyways and stores within the vicinity. All clear.
Welfare check completed at JB Hi-Fi, One NZ, and Michael Hill. All clear.
Welfare check completed at Vulcan Lane and all stores within the vicinity. All clear.
Welfare check and building sweep completed around Imperial Lane. All clear.
Welfare check completed at Queens Arcade. All clear.
Arrived at Commercial Bay check-in. Full sweep completed. All clear. Alpha Route ended. Returning to headquarters to conduct building sweep.
Patrols recommenced. Due to heavy rain, welfare checks conducted slowly using sheltered areas to maintain visible presence.
Echo Route commenced. Arrived at check-in, corner of Darby Street and Queen Street. All clear.
Welfare check completed at Woolworths Victoria Street West. All clear.
Welfare check completed at Lord Nelson's Steak House and Scrunchy Millers. All clear.
Arrived at check-in, top of Victoria Street and Federal Street. All clear.
Welfare check completed at 77 Convenience Store and Subway. All clear.
Welfare check completed at Dunkin Donuts and Durham Street West alleyway. All clear.
Welfare checks completed on stores along Queen Street. Most closed due to shorter public holiday trading hours; checks still conducted.
Arrived at Chancery Square and Freyberg Square check-in. All clear.
Welfare checks completed on stores within Chancery. All clear.
Welfare check completed at Shortland Street Convenience Store and Taco Bell. All clear.
Arrived at check-in, corner of Shortland Street and Queen Street. All clear.
Arrived at Queens Arcade check-in. All clear.
Welfare check completed at Q Convenience Store. All clear. Presence maintained under shelter.
Echo Route ended. Welfare checks continued up and down main Queen Street.
Welfare check completed at Albert Mart Convenience Store and Discount Dairy and Vape Shop. All clear.
Welfare check completed at Ace Karaoke and Good2Go Convenience Store. All clear.
Security presence maintained at Ace Karaoke Bar under shelter.
Lunch break completed. Preparing for changeover to night shift.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Night shift deployed. Equipment received: 3x bodyvests, 2x keycards, 1x Ops phone, 4x set of keys, 1x bodycam, 1x Ops phone charger, and 2x body camera chargers.
Alpha Route commenced. Check-in completed at Chemist Warehouse and Kathmandu. No issues.
Full sweep completed at Vulcan Lane. All clear, no issues.
Check-in completed at McDonald's Britomart. No issues.
Patrolling Commercial Bay. Full sweep commenced.
Commercial Bay full sweep completed. All clear, no issues. Streets quiet tonight.
Check-in completed at Albert Street Convenience Store. No issues.
Check-in completed at 77 Convenience Store. No issues.
Full sweep completed at Victoria Street. All clear, no issues.
Floor checks completed. Ops phone placed on charge as battery was at 5%.
Patrolling Aotea Square. Full sweep commenced.
Aotea Square full sweep completed. All clear, no issues.
Check-in completed at McDonald's Queen Street. No issues.
Full sweep completed at Freyberg Square, Chancery Square, and Kitchener Street. All clear, no issues.
Full sweep completed at Fort Street and Wilson Carpark. All clear, no issues.
Check-in completed at Gore Street. All clear. Due to weather, surfaces were wet and slippery; patrol continued with caution.
Check-in completed at St Patrick's Cathedral Church. All clear, no issues.
Check-in completed at 77 Convenience Store. No issues.
Full sweep completed at Victoria Street. Road workers present, no issues to report.
Check-in completed at corner of Lorne Street and Wakefield Street. All clear, no issues.
Check-in completed at Aotea Square. All clear, no issues.
Check-in completed at McDonald's Queen Street. No issues.
Check-in completed at Elliott Street and Wilson Carpark. All clear, no issues.
Check-in completed at Durham Street. All clear, no issues.
Full sweep completed at Wyndham Street. All clear, no issues.
Check-in completed at Freyberg Square, Chancery Square, and Kitchener Street. All clear, no issues.
Check-in completed at Fort Street and Wilson Carpark. All clear, no issues.
Check-in completed at McDonald's Britomart and Commercial Bay. No issues to report.
Check-in completed at St Patrick's Cathedral Church. All clear, no issues.
Check-in completed at 77 Convenience Store. No issues.
Check-in completed at Aotea Square. All clear, no issues.
